item.title: 26k-Mile 2010 Jaguar XKR Coupe
item.description: This 2010 Jaguar XKR coupe has 26k miles following history with two registered owners, and it is powered by a supercharged 5.0-liter V8 paired with a six-speed automatic transmission and an active limited-slip differential. item.title: Modified 1949 GMC 150 Pickup
item.description: This 1949 GMC 150 five-window pickup was refurbished and modified under prior ownership with work that involved grafting a mid-1970s Nova front subframe to the frame as well as installing a 350ci V8 linked to a 700R4 four-speed automatic transmission and a 10-bolt rear end. Inside, a contoured bench seat is trimmed in tan leather and accompanied by a tilting steering wheel, Dolphin gauges, a Lokar shifter, a Custom Autosound stereo unit, and an under-dash air conditioning unit. item.title: 2006 Porsche 911 Carrera S Cabriolet 6-Speed
item.description: This 2006 Porsche 911 Carrera S cabriolet was initially delivered to Don Rosen Imports of Conshohocken, Pennsylvania, and it has 52k miles. It is finished in Forest Green Metallic over a Sand Beige leather interior and is powered by a 3.8-liter flat-six paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 49k-Mile 2015 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition 5-Speed
item.description: This 2015 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition is one of 1,600 examples produced for the US market, and it was acquired by the current owner in 2019. Finished in Octane Blue Pearl over black cloth, the car is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-four linked to a five-speed manual transaxle and an all-wheel-drive system. item.title: 2018 Mercedes-AMG E63 S 4MATIC Sedan
item.description: This 2018 Mercedes-AMG E63 S 4MATIC sedan is finished in Designo Cardinal Red Metallic over Black Nappa leather and Dinamica and was ordered with nearly $21k in options. The car spent time in Arizona before the seller purchased it in 2020, and they have since added approximately 30k of the 38k indicated miles. item.title: 2004 Ducati 998S Final Edition at No Reserve
item.description: This 2004 Ducati 998S Final Edition was acquired by the seller in February 2025, and it now shows 5k miles. Powered by a 998cc Testastretta DOHC L-twin paired with a six-speed transmission, the motorcycle is finished in red with tricolore accents and silver graphics. item.title: 700-Mile 2004 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra Mystichrome Convertible
item.description: This 2004 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra is one of 495 convertibles equipped with the Mystichrome appearance package for the model year, and this example spent time in New Jersey before it was acquired by the current owner on BaT in April 2021. Now indicating under 700 miles, the car is powered by a supercharged 4.6-liter DOHC V8 linked with a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 22k-Mile 2005 Lotus Elise at No Reserve
item.description: This 2005 Lotus Elise has 22k miles, and it has spent most of its time registered in California. The car was purchased by the seller on BaT in September 2025 following about 17 years in the prior owner's care. It is finished in Arctic Silver Metallic and is powered by a 1.8-liter inline-four paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 2012 Ferrari FF
item.description: This 2012 Ferrari FF was first delivered to Ferrari of Washington in Sterling, Virginia, and it is finished in Blu Swaters over beige Tradizione leather. Power is from a 6.3-liter F140 V12 linked to an all-wheel-drive system incorporating a rear-mounted seven-speed dual-clutch transaxle and a front-mounted two-speed transaxle.
